title: Water Watch Dashboard
subtitle: Satellite NDWI multi-temporal lake surface area and regional groundwater depth telemetry
earlyWarningMessage: Critical surface contraction detected! Surface area has fallen by more than {{pct}}% over the recent observation cycle.
ndwiTooltipText: Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) isolates open water bodies from space by comparing reflected green light and near-infrared absorption. Higher values outline true surface water boundaries.
gwTooltipText: Measured in meters below ground level (mbgl). As this number rises, the underground water table is sinking deeper, indicating depletion of local aquifers.
